title: Save Mum!
tagline: A rescue game dreamed up by a 6 year old.
blurb: Zombies burst out of the cupboard and carry Mum off to a secret lab. Pick the Smart Kid, who hacks bad guys into party zombies, or the Strong Kid, who punches. Jump and crouch past chomper lasers, spin kick a ring of skeletons, cross the goo and break the evil crystal's spell. Nobody can get hurt. Designed out loud by a 6 year old in a treehouse, built with Claude.

pad.hint: stick: move · button: hit · down + button: spin
